static_traits.name: 陈铭

static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的互动因一次被嘲笑“披萨烤糊”事件受到影响，Self-doubt延伸到人际连接能力
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病史；not yet接受过既往心理治疗

basic_info.main_problem: 我想讨论的是我的without能感和Self-doubt，这些感受是在朋友批评我的烹饪时被trigger的，并逐步扩散到生活的其他方面。
basic_info.core_demands: 这次朋友的评论让我意识到Self-doubt和without能感正在影响我的自尊与总体福祉，因此我希望通过咨询加以应对与改变。
growth_experiences: Mother曾罹患癌症并成功康复，这一家庭重大事件构成来访者的背景信息。

special_situations.event: Friends comment that the pizza I made is burnt and laugh at me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次被批评或犯错，就说明我not擅长这件事、我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍练习烹饪、严格遵循食谱和use计时器；寻求他人认可来证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远学not会把披萨做好

special_situations.event: When facing challenges or receiving any form of criticism from others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能一次就做对或被指出错误，说明我整体能力not足、就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少与朋友分享真实感受；通过寻求外部赞许来缓解not安

special_situations.event: After interacting with friends, begins to doubt her interpersonal skills and ability to connect with people
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人因为我的错误嘲笑我，说明我在人际上也not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避表达without能感与Self-doubt，保持情感收敛以避免再次被评价

special_situations.event: 练习烹饪时出现一点小错误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任何小失误都能证明我做not好、总体not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断加练、严格按步骤操作，试图以完美表现Undoingnot安

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, hopes one's performance is seen positively
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评与嘲笑，担心被全盘negate与羞辱
defense_goal: 通过内化他人评价并提高标准来避免再次被negate；保持收敛与Self-monitoring以维持自尊的安全感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易被责难的失败者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others point out mistakes, mention 'cooking failure', or offer criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的单次评论理解为对自己整体价值与能力的全盘negate（移情：把外部评价当作决定性真相）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和而稳健，先Empathy其羞耻与not安，再邀请区分“具体行为反馈”与“整体自我价值”，use具体化Questioning帮助其看到情境与证据的边界。

manifestations: 因被嘲笑披萨烤糊而Self-doubt，开始质疑自己的人际连接能力
难以向朋友分享without能感与Self-doubt

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worried that failure will lead to worse feelings; stays cautious about action
在他人批评后过度关注自身not足

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes a friend's single mockery into a comprehensive judgment of one's own ability
Takes external criticism as a hard standard for measuring personal worth

positive_force: 愿意尝试not同方法并保持开放心态（愿意进行行为实验）
具备一定的Reflection能力，能观察并描述自己的自动化思维
Has a few contactable friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Tendency to seek external validation to confirm self-worth
Personalizes criticism; easily extends a single event to overall ability
难以向他人分享脆弱感受，导致支持without法充分进入

target_behavior.behavior: 在面对挑战或收到批评时出现强烈的Self-denial与Withdrawal（认知与情绪反应伴随）
antecedent: 尝试新的任务或skill（如烹饪）
When others point out mistakes or give negative feedback
练习过程中出现小失误
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人批评内化为对整体能力的评判，形成‘我not行’的核心信念；伴随过度概括与非黑即白的认知方式。
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻感、通过谨慎与寻求外部认可来暂时缓解not安
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、行动胆怯、日常生活信心下降；对人际连接产生怀疑，学习与skill提升受阻
